acceptanceCriteria: Both control and nested-heading fixtures fail and name TestNeverDeclared at its indexed source line.
A heading at or above the outer opening depth still closes inspection.
Deeper nonmatching headings and repeated deeper traceability headings preserve scanning.

body:
Comprehensive expert audit 2026-09-26, TEST-01. Audited source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a. Evidence classification: confirmed.

An indexed spec contains ## Traceability, then ### Nested traceability, then ### Other witnesses and a table citing an undeclared TestNeverDeclared. The nested matching heading overwrites the outer depth; its sibling closes scanning although it remains inside the original section. Both local gate and CI documentation checks can accept the nonexistent witness.

Source: script/check-traceability-tests.sh:99; docs/specs/traceability-test-gate-v0.md:54; script/check-traceability-tests_test.sh:23

Owning contract/status: "TTG-V0-003; TTG-V0-005; TTG-V0-009"

Verification: "Scratch Git-index fixture reproduces exit 0 for nested-heading case and exit 1 for control missing-test row; tests-heading-repro.json. Existing traceability fixture exits 0. No full gate run."

Suggested correction: Preserve the outer active traceability depth when encountering deeper matching headings, and add nested/sibling heading regression fixtures.

Related TEST-02: A regression that admits an untracked test declaration can leave current indexed specs passing traceability-tests-check. The existing negative fixture would catch this regression, but Makefile GATE_STEPS and CI do not invoke it; no Go or script harness reference was found. Invoke the existing shell fixture from a normal documentation verification target/CI step; include TEST-01 regression in that fixture.

Report: .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md; retained expert and reproduction evidence in .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/. Run focused regressions and owning documentation checks; exhaustive gate only when governing release policy requires it. No implementation, intent acceptance or promotion is claimed.
